subject: Palletizer Perception | Working w/ Pickle Robot & Ambi
text:
Hi [NAME],

I saw you're developing palletizer application and recently hiring a
perception engineer so I thought to reach out. We help Pickle Robot, Ambi
Robotics and Siemens Robotics developing computer vision modules for
palletizing capabilities, thought it's worth connecting.

For context - Encord is the leading data development platform for over 200
computer vision teams. We consolidate data curation, annotation and model
evaluation in one platform, with the goals of accelerating perception model
development for Physical AI teams.

Curious to hear how you're thinking about the perception stack and happy to
share perspectives on how we've helped other robotics teams. Let me know if
you're open to a chat Tuesday to Friday next week?

subject: lip syncing - working w/ flawless, synthesia and captions
text:
Hi [NAME],

I saw you're hiring MLEs and Research Scientists for generative models and
face tracking so I thought to reach out. We work with Flawless, Synthesia
and Captions to develop their computer vision models for very similar use
cases: lip syncing and video generation. Thought it might be a good time to
chat!

For context - We're a computer vision data development platform of choice
for over 200 AI teams. We've tailored our workflow for generative AI teams
with video-native data curation & annotation and advanced face-tracking
annotation capabilities.

Curious how you're thinking about developing your CV features, and happy to
share our perspectives from working within the space. Let me know if you're
open to a quick chat Tuesday to Friday next week?

subject: Working w/ SmartEye, Cipia & Toyota | [COMPANY] Autosense
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

I noticed [COMPANY]'s recent focus on DMS - especially the EU homologation & large automotive contracts - so thought I'd reach out. I lead an automotive team here at Encord and we're working w/ a few of your peers (SmartEye, Toyota, Cipia, Nauto, Seeing Machines, etc) to develop new AI/CV products & scale use cases like driver behavior analytics, in-cabin monitoring, safety alerts & 2D/3D Skeletons using a single-camera OMS. 

We're mostly assisting with multimodal data visualisation at scale (billions) & dimensionality reduction for feature engineering, edge case mining & model eval for decision threshold tuning and annotation workflow orchestration as the team size grows or as they expand into more complex modalities like video or audio. 

Keen to trade notes & get your thoughts on what we're building if you're be open to a 30-minute chat this week or the next? Wednesdays and Thursdays usually work for me.

subject: Scaling LFM development
text:
Hey [NAME]​,

Have been following the Liquid AI team for some time now & has been exciting to see how Liquid has supported its customers fine-tuning VLMs across E-commerce & Automotive AI, so thought I'd reach out to explore potential areas of overlap. 

I lead a Multimodal team here at Encord and we've been working with several similar frontier AI teams (inc. Thinking Machines, H company, Figure AI) - providing the development platform to consolidate multimodal AI data curation, visualisation, and HITL verification flows (pre- and post- training) to accelerate development of Multimodal models (e.g. VLMs & Speech-to-Speech)

Would love to connect & understand more about your plans to scale further - also happy to share our learnings from working with similar frontier Multimodal teams,

Interested in having a quick chat?

subject: Working w/ Toyota & GE | Hi from [SENDER] @ Encord
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

I lead a manufacturing & industrial applications team here at Encord (~6 years old, 100+ employees & $50M+ funding) and we're working with a few of your peers (Toyota, Bosch, Siemens, Honeywell, General Electric, etc) to expand into new AI/Computer Vision products & scale use cases like Automated Surface Inspection Systems (ASIS), new material discovery, predictive maintenance, quality control, worker safety, etc. 

I've been following ArcelorMittal's Global R&D and Downstream Solutions work for some time, so keen to trade notes & get your thoughts on what we're building if you're be open to a 30-minute chat this week or the next? Wednesdays and Thursdays usually work for me.
